stories.title: Tarlanın üstüne güneş paneli kurdu: Yarısını komşulara veriyor

en.title: Built solar panels over the field: Sharing half with neighbors
en.summary: A U.S. farmer installed 832 solar panels on his land to generate his own electricity while continuing agricultural operations and sharing benefits with neighboring properties.

stories.title: MHP'den AYM'nin Tayfun Kahraman kararına net yorum: "Tartışılacak bir tarafı yok"

en.title: Clear statement from MHP on Constitutional Court's Tayfun Kahraman decision: "There is nothing to dispute"
en.summary: The MHP party commented on a Constitutional Court ruling regarding Tayfun Kahraman, a defendant in the Gezi Park case, concerning a second rights violation and retrial decision.

stories.title: Araştırma: Kanser artık daha genç yaşlarda görülüyor

en.title: Research: Cancer is now appearing at younger ages
en.summary: Analysis of data from England, the United States, and the Netherlands shows increased incidence of seven cancer types in people under 50, particularly prostate, colorectal, kidney, and endometrial cancers, which experts consider concerning.

stories.title: Türkiye Belediyeler Birliği'nde koltuk bir kez daha boşaldı: Vahap Seçer'in tutuklanması sonrası seçim yapılacak

en.title: Another leadership position emptied at Turkish Municipalities Union: Election to be held following Vahap Seçer's detention
en.summary: The detention of Mersin Metropolitan Mayor Vahap Seçer triggers a new election process for the Turkish Municipalities Union following previous leadership changes due to detentions of other officials.

stories.title: Bekir Bozdağ, TBMM Başkanvekilliği görevinden istifa etti

en.title: Bekir Bozdağ resigns from position as Deputy Speaker of TBMM
en.summary: Bekir Bozdağ, an AKP member of parliament from Şanlıurfa, has resigned from his role as Deputy Speaker of the Turkish Grand National Assembly citing health reasons.

stories.title: Akın Gürlek fon vurgunu için 'liste elimizde' dedi: Sadece 5 kişi paraları iade etti

en.title: Akın Gürlek says 'we have the list' regarding fund embezzlement: Only 5 people returned money
en.summary: Justice Minister Akın Gürlek stated that his ministry has a list of individuals involved in a fund investigation and noted that only five people have returned money so far.

en.title: 'Mardin's Marilyn Monroe' sentenced to prison
en.summary: Melek Karahan, known as 'Mardin's Marilyn Monroe', received a prison sentence of one year and three months for social media posts related to the July 15 coup attempt attributed to FETÖ.

stories.title: Bakan Akın Gürlek’ten 'fon vurgunu' açıklaması: '5 kişi TMSF'ye iadede bulundu'

en.title: Minister Akın Gürlek explains 'fund embezzlement': '5 people made returns to TMSF'
en.summary: Justice Minister Akın Gürlek announced that voluntary refund accounts were opened under TMSF for the fund investigation, with five individuals making returns, and clarified this does not close the investigation.

en.title: 'Mardin's Marilyn Monroe' sentenced to 1 year 3 months in prison!
en.summary: Melek Karahan, 50, known as 'Marilyn Monroe of Mardin', received a prison sentence related to social media posts concerning the July 15 coup attempt attributed to FETÖ.

stories.title: ‘Mardinli Marilyn Monroe’ davasında karar çıktı: 1 yıl 3 ay hapis cezası

en.title: Verdict reached in 'Mardin's Marilyn Monroe' case: 1 year 3 months prison sentence
en.summary: Melek Karahan, 50, known as 'Marilyn Monroe of Mardin', was sentenced to 1 year 3 months in prison for social media posts made from her account.

stories.title: Deneyimli gazeteci Recep Levent Öztürk hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Experienced journalist Recep Levent Öztürk has died
en.summary: TRT Haber correspondent Recep Levent Öztürk, 56, suffered a heart attack while attending an event in Akçakoca and died at the hospital.

stories.title: Katıldığı programda kalp krizi geçirmişti: TRT Haber muhabiri Recep Levent Öztürk hayatını kaybetti

en.title: He suffered a heart attack at an event: TRT Haber correspondent Recep Levent Öztürk has died
en.summary: TRT Haber correspondent Recep Levent Öztürk, 56, collapsed from a heart attack while attending a program in Akçakoca and subsequently died in hospital.

stories.title: Yapay zekâda işverenin tercihi değişti: Basit becerilere talep düşüyor

en.title: Employer preferences shift in artificial intelligence: demand for basic skills falling
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is reshaping workplace skill requirements. According to new global research, demand for basic AI skills is declining as companies increasingly seek workers who can develop tools, automate workflows, and implement AI solutions.

stories.title: Nobel Fizik Ödülü'nün sahibi belli oldu

en.title: Nobel Prize in Physics 2026 winner announced
en.summary: Belgian-American physicist Francis Halzen has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos. He receives a monetary prize of 12 million Swedish kronor.

stories.title: Ebola bir ülkede daha görüldü! Hasta hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Ebola detected in another country as patient dies
en.summary: Kenya's Health Minister announced the country's first confirmed Ebola case, resulting in one death. The patient traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi, and 28 contacts including family members and healthcare workers have been identified.

stories.title: Veba salgını kapıda mı? Sibirya'daki ölüm sonrası DSÖ'den ilk açıklama

en.title: Is plague at the door? First WHO statement after Siberian death
en.summary: A laboratory worker in Siberia died from pneumonia of undetermined cause, triggering concerns about potential plague outbreak. The WHO has contacted Russian authorities to provide initial assessment of possible epidemic risk as contact tracing continues and laboratory tests proceed.

stories.title: TCMB (Merkez Bankası) faiz kararı ne zaman açıklanacak? MB faiz indirecek mi?

en.title: When will the TCMB (Central Bank) interest rate decision be announced? Will the CB cut rates?
en.summary: Recent inflation figures came in below expectations, with annual inflation falling below 30 percent. Attention now turns to whether Turkey's central bank will implement an interest rate cut.
